messages:
maya (design): quick design drop 1  — trying a 'role quickbar' that sits above the members table for first-time admins. compact, single-row controls: Pick role, Add, and a small 'help' icon. intent: speed up single invites. screenshot + flow in figma.
liam (pm): i like the speed idea. question: does quickbar replace the invite drawer or just a shortcut? we still need bulk invites.
maya (design): shortcut only. quickbar opens the invite drawer with the role pre-selected. if user wants bulk, drawer has the existing multi-email textarea.
samir (frontend): implementation note: preselecting via URL hash or query param is easiest: /invite?role=editor. will prototype. keyboard focus needs to land on the email input when opened.
elaine (a11y): focus landing is critical. also the quickbar needs a descriptive accessible name: "Quick invite as <role>" and visible focus indicator. ensure contrast for hover/active states >= 4.5:1.
jonah (research): we tested similar micro-controls in last sprint — conversion for single invites jumped ~9%. worth measuring here. also suggest a tiny tooltip that explains role differences on hover.
liam (pm): copy: current invite header reads "Invite people". research said novices prefer "Add your team". maya, can you craft two variants for an experiment?
maya (design): will create A/B: "Add your team" vs "Invite your team". short subcopy: "They'll get an invite to join {org}". quickbar label will say "Quick invite as: [Viewer] [Editor] [Admin]".
samir (frontend): SSO enforcement: some orgs have enforced SSO. Instead of a blocking modal, propose an inline badge inside the drawer: lock icon + "SSO required" with a small link "How this affects invites" that opens docs.
elaine (a11y): badge must have aria-describedby and the link should be keyboard reachable. also announce the SSO state when the drawer opens using aria-live polite. dynamic changes to enforcement should use role="alert" if they affect available actions.
liam (pm): product rule: if SSO is enforced for the org, external/non-domain emails should show a soft validation: "Invited email may be forced to sign in via SSO" and prevent invites only if admin policy forbids external accounts. we'll surface policy link.
maya (design): visual: SSO badge in the drawer header, yellow subtle bg for warning. plus an optional tooltip on hover with the idp name.
jonah (research): mask emails in any preview or micro-sandbox. users care about privacy. show only domain and initials unless owner role viewing.
samir (frontend): micro-sandbox idea: hover the quickbar badge to reveal the last 3 role-change events (actor + action + time). implement as aria-hidden by default and reveal on focus/hover. need to ensure it's not a full iframe.
elaine (a11y): micro-sandbox must be keyboard operable and not trap focus. when it appears, set focusable elements in it and provide a close action. also ensure screen reader can read the entries as a list with proper names: "Alice changed Bob from Viewer to Editor, 3 days ago".
maya (design): small tweak: show anonymized entries by default, e.g., "Admin changed a role 3 days ago" with a link "View details" that navigates to audit log.
liam (pm): audit link should pre-filter: /settings/audit?event=role_change&period=14d. ensure perms check so people without access see a tooltip that says "Request access".
samir (frontend): will add permission gate client-side and fall back to a tooltip that links to request flow. also ensure the pre-filter does not leak PII. server will handle final masking.
elaine (a11y): on the audit results page, after filters apply, announce "Showing X results for role changes in last 14 days" via aria-live polite. rows should have accessible names combining actor and action.
jonah (research): let's track two metrics: time-to-complete-first-invite and invite-abandon rate. A/B the header copy and quickbar present vs absent.
maya (design): ok pushing assets. small ask: change selected state color from light teal to deeper blue (#0b6a6a?) to meet contrast.
samir (frontend): i'll pick accessible palette and fix focus outline. planning a branch by Thu EOD. infra-bot: preview URL will be posted.
liam (pm): great. QA priorities: keyboard nav, screen-reader labels, SSO banner behavior, audit deep-link gating. post checklists here.
elaine (a11y): i'll prepare a short checklist and schedule a 30-min pass when branch is ready.
maya (design): thanks! i'll also add copy variants and the anonymized micro-sandbox copy to figma.
jonah (research): will set up experiment and instrumentation notes. will share events and recommended thresholds.
liam (pm): perfect. update this thread with preview link and any follow-up issues. :rocket:
